**ABOUT SYLUX** 





 SYLUX, Powered by Compal, is a Tier One automotive technology company focused on infrared sensing and AI\-powered perception systems for advanced vehicle safety. Our production\-ready infrared cameras and perception software help vehicles detect pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, and road hazards in darkness, glare, fog, rain, snow, and other challenging conditions where traditional sensors struggle.
 





 Built on decades of engineering and manufacturing expertise, SYLUX combines advanced R\&D, scalable production, and global collaboration to deliver next\-generation safety technologies for ADAS and automated driving applications. Through innovation in infrared sensing, AI perception, simulation, and real\-world validation, we work closely with OEMs and technology partners to improve mobility safety worldwide.
 




  





**OUR CULTURE** 





 At SYLUX, we believe innovation happens when passionate people collaborate to solve meaningful challenges. Our culture encourages creativity, continuous learning, and global teamwork across engineering, product, and technical marketing disciplines.
 





 We are building technologies that help save lives and improve mobility safety, while creating an environment where employees can grow, contribute ideas, and work on cutting\-edge automotive innovations.
 




  





**Vehicle Application Software Engineer** 




**Location:** 
 Farmington Hills, Michigan
 



**Reports To:** 
 Global Director of Technical Marketing
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 SYLUX is seeking a highly motivated
 **Vehicle Application Software Engineer** 
 to join our team in Farmington Hills, Michigan. This position will focus on the development, integration, and validation of advanced software features for SYLUX automotive infrared perception and safety systems.
 



 The Vehicle Application Software Engineer will bridge software development, vehicle integration, ADAS feature development, and real\-world validation. The role will transform SYLUX infrared camera and CDAT™ AI perception capabilities into functional vehicle features, including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Forward Collision Warning (FCW), Rear AEB, Safe Door Opening, Adaptive Cruise Control, and other next\-generation safety applications. This is a hands\-on engineering position that requires software development and direct interaction with vehicles, sensors, CAN networks, test equipment, and demonstration platforms.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**Software Development** 



* Design, develop, integrate, and validate software features utilizing SYLUX infrared cameras and CDAT™ AI perception software.
* Develop, maintain and optimize a globally shared vehicle application used across the engineering teams.
* Translate system and customer requirements into functional software features and vehicle\-level behaviors.
* Support feature development from proof\-of\-concept to customer\-ready vehicle demonstration, validation, and customer evaluation.
* Develop algorithms that convert perception output (object classification, distance, tracking, vehicle speed) into vehicle warnings, decisions, and control actions.
* Perform driver and kernel\-level hardware bring\-up, diagnosing and resolving low\-level driver and kernel module installation issues.
* Extend perception\-based feature logic to support new and evolving ADAS applications, including:



 o  Forward Collision Warning (FCW)
 



 o  Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB)
 



 o  Rear Automatic Braking (RAB)
 



 o  Safe Door Opening (SDO)
 



 o  Blind Spot Monitoring (BSM)
 



 o  Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)
 



 o  Parking and Low\-Speed Safety Features
 



 o  Additional infrared\-enabled ADAS and automated driving applications
 



  





**Vehicle Integration \& Controls** 



* Communicate with vehicles using CAN bus and DBC databases, including signal encoding/decoding and real\-time processing of vehicle\-state data.
* Design and maintain vehicle interface, communication and database structures supporting multiple vehicle types and platforms.
* Integrate external hardware devices into the application via low\-level signal and serial communication.
* Troubleshoot ROS2 framework issues, including node communication, topic/message flow, and publisher/subscriber configuration.
* Support reverse engineering and characterization of vehicle interfaces when required for prototype and demonstration development.
* Design vehicle architecture diagrams showing all in\-vehicle connections and data flow between components.
* Support hardware installation, system calibration, troubleshooting, and vehicle builds.
* Optimize communication between perception systems and vehicle controllers to provide reliable real\-time operation.
* Support road/proving\-ground testing and data collection for AI model development/validation.
* Work closely with AI, embedded software, systems, hardware, vehicle integration, and Technical Marketing teams.
* Collaborate with SYLUX global engineering teams to integrate new cameras, perception, and software capabilities.








**Demonstration \& Customer Support** 



* Support customer vehicle evaluations, technical workshops, ride\-and\-drive events, and engineering demonstrations.
* Provide technical explanations and demonstrations to OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, technology partners, and other customers.
